test_config_loads: test that example config YAML files load into valid Config objects without errors
test_evaluator_has_evaluate_function: test that an evaluator module exposes a callable evaluate function via dynamic import
test_evaluator_runs_on_initial_program: test that the evaluator can score an initial program and return a combined_score metric
test_database_stores_and_retrieves_progr: test that the ProgramDatabase can store and retrieve Program objects by their unique id
test_evaluators_are_importable: test that all evaluator modules in the examples directory can be imported and have an evaluate function
